preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: MIX
  description: Mix components except yeast extract, bovine serum albumin and Na2S·9H2O.
- step_number: 2
  action: HEAT
  description: Bring to a boil for 5-10 sec and flush with N2.
- step_number: 3
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: Adjust pH to 7.6 at 80-90C.
- step_number: 4
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: After cooling to room temperature, dispense the medium into serum bottles
    under a N2 atmosphere, seal with butyl rubber stoppers and autoclave.
- step_number: 5
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Separately autoclave yeast extract as a 10% solution and neutralized
    Na2S·9H2O as a 5% solution under a N2 atmosphere.
- step_number: 6
  action: FILTER
  description: Filter-sterilize bovine serum albumin as a 10% (w/v) solution under
    a N2 atmosphere.
- step_number: 7
  action: MIX
  description: Before inoculation, aseptically and anaerobically add the yeast extract,
    bovine serum albumin and neutralized Na2S·9H2O solutions.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Mix components except yeast extract, bovine serum albumin and Na2S
    x 9H2O. Bring to a boil for 5-10 sec and flush with N2. Adjust pH to 7.6 at 80-90C.
    After cooling to room temperature, dispense the medium into serum bottles under
    a N2 atmosphere, seal with butyl rubber stoppers and autoclave. Separately autoclave
    yeast extract as a 10% solution and neutralized Na2S x 9H2O as a 5% solution under
    a N2 atmosphere. Filter-sterilize bovine serum albumin as a 10% (w/v) solution
    under a N2 atmosphere. Before inoculation, aseptically and anaerobically add the
    yeast extract, bovine serum albumin and neutralized Na2S x 9H2O solutions.

preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: MIX
  description: Mix components except yeast extract, bovine serum albumin and Na2S·9H2O.
- step_number: 2
  action: HEAT
  description: Bring to a boil for 5-10 sec and flush with N2.
- step_number: 3
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: Adjust pH to 7.6 at 80-90C.
- step_number: 4
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: After cooling to room temperature, dispense the medium into serum bottles
    under a N2 atmosphere, seal with butyl rubber stoppers and autoclave.
- step_number: 5
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: Separately autoclave yeast extract as a 10% solution and neutralized
    Na2S·9H2O as a 5% solution under a N2 atmosphere.
- step_number: 6
  action: FILTER
  description: Filter-sterilize bovine serum albumin as a 10% (w/v) solution under
    a N2 atmosphere.
- step_number: 7
  action: MIX
  description: Before inoculation, aseptically and anaerobically add the yeast extract,
    bovine serum albumin and neutralized Na2S·9H2O solutions.
